result:
Round 128 **passes**. Footer-button fix C-R127-01 now holds in the real browser at both 1440×900 and 1280×720. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I made no changes to `store/`, and the source tree was the same at the start and end of my checks.

**What I checked:**
- **Duplicate button name:** each dialog has exactly one `Close` (the ✕) and one `Done` (the footer button). No two buttons share a name when the dialog is idle, during a WAV render, after an export or after a cancel. I counted with exact-name role queries and an accessibility snapshot. During a render `Done` is disabled and the ✕ stays enabled.
- **Keyboard:** focus lands on `Done` when the dialog opens. Tab and Shift+Tab order, Escape, focus returning to the toolbar Export, and holding Enter all behave exactly as in round 127, with `Done` in place of `Close`.
- **Wording:** all five changes show correctly in the browser:
  - the Video option says "in this version";
  - with Loop on, the notes say "the time selection is exported" (4.000 s) and "the entire project is exported";
  - WAV and MP3 cancels say "no file was created" in lowercase;
  - a range export reports "WAV created: time selection 00:02.000 — 00:06.000 (4.000 s)".
  - No Georgian text remains, except the video "no audio" note that belongs to the next stage (V-0.2).
- **Export output is unchanged:** the full-project WAV is 7,217,877 frames, 48 kHz / 24-bit / stereo; the range WAV is 192,000 frames.
- **Layout:** the only change is the footer button, 2 px narrower because "Done" is shorter. Everything else is within 1 px of the earlier baseline.
- **Tests:** A's 25 test files pass (316 tests, the same as A reported), including the 15 that failed last round and the new uniqueness test.
- **Code diff:** the changes stay inside the allowed files. In the 6 files where only test titles were allowed to change, every changed line is a title.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:** a fresh session with no login gets "Sign in required" on `/studio/middle-east`, loads no audio, and the token API returns 401.
- **Network and errors:** no forbidden requests and no auth headers were sent; there were no hydration errors.

**For B:**
- **New Low, C-R128-L1:** at 1280 after a range export, the ✕ is half cut off at the top of the dialog. Round 127's screenshot shows the same thing, so this round did not cause it. It goes to `deferred_low_polish` and does not affect the PASS.
- **Not reachable in the browser:** six error messages (empty project, invalid range, encoder load failure or timeout, export failure, MP3 failure) only appear in unit tests. I listed them as inconclusive, not passed.
- **Blocked:** the fake-Bearer 403 check needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud.
- **Discarded run:** the first 1440 run crashed on first load (the known environment issue), so I replaced it with a new run.
- **My mistake:** my first test command expanded the file list wrongly and ran the whole suite (all green). I did not count it, since the full suite is the gate's job, and re-ran the exact 25 files.
- **Ableton:** I checked B's saved copy of the Live 12 manual myself, and it does use "time selection".

Per the round plan, round 129 is V-0.2.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-128.md
- c-round-128.json
- c-round-128/ (tools, out, shots)
